[[File:Rocket Prize Master.png|thumb|250px|The Rocket Prize Master]]
The '''Rocket Prize Master''' (Japanese: '''ロケット・ガチャット''' ''Rocket Gachat'') is a [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]] used by {{TRT}} in {{aniseries|JN}}. It is a {{wp|Gashapon|capsule toy vending machine}} filled with many [[Poké Ball]]s, and it is delivered to the required location by {{OBP|Pelipper|Team Rocket|Team Rocket's Pelipper}}. By inserting {{MTR}}'s {{wp|Koban (coin)|charm}} and turning the crank, one or two Poké Balls are dispensed for [[Jessie]] and [[James]] to temporarily use. The Rocket Prize Master first appeared in ''[[JN003|Ivysaur's Mysterious Tower!]]''.

The Poké Balls dispensed by the Rocket Prize Master are purple and branded with the [[Team Rocket]] insignia, and they will always drop a leaflet containing basic information of the Pokémon, including their name, {{pkmn|category}}, and [[move]]s, when thrown. The coloration indicates the Pokémon they contain are the property of Team Rocket rather than that of Jessie and James themselves.
